counts_source.description: LDBC FinBench Transaction entity counts per scale factor (raw generated data)

tables.discrepancy: LDBC's table counts the generated data (raw/); the loaded graph is the archive's snapshot/, and incremental/ adds held_back rows for the write workload, which a read-only load does not apply. raw/ also keeps deleted_in_raw rows of accounts deleted during generation (deleteTime set); residual of them are in neither snapshot/ nor incremental/.
